elements.element: No liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer (preferred)
elements.evidence: "the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment")" remains operative

elements.element: Early-termination fee is capped at 3 months' fees
elements.evidence: "equal to the lesser of (i) the aggregate Net Sales ... and (ii) 3 months' fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1"

elements.element: The capped amount is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer on termination
elements.evidence: "The Termination Payment shall be the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company by reason of termination of this Agreement."

elements.element: Fee is triggered by/limited to early termination by Customer
elements.evidence: "In the event the Company terminates this Agreement"

reasons: Fallback is complete: the lesser-of limb hard-caps the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees, and the inserted sentence makes it the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company on termination.
Preferred is not met because a Customer-payable termination payment survives; this is consistent with the locked fallback target.
Minimality holds: the original formula is left intact and only a lesser-of cap operator plus one short exclusivity sentence were added; no whole-clause rewrite and no new exceptions.
Intent preserved: the quarterly eight-instalment payment mechanic in (c) and the 90-day notice/Termination Date machinery are untouched.

Minor note (rationale only, not a deviation): the cap cross-refers to "Section 3.1" as the fee source; if that section is not the Company's fee obligation the reference should be conformed to avoid a dangling cross-reference.
